prompt: Build the supplier contacts register: name, role, email and when we last contacted them, with a search and a way to create a contact.
Build the supplier record's page header: a breadcrumb back to Suppliers, the supplier's name, and an Actions menu with Edit supplier and Archive supplier.
When a supplier has no reviews yet, the Reviews tab should show a proper empty state with a way to start the first review.
Build the supplier Details panel: status, owner, country and when it was last reviewed, as labelled properties.
